welcome.title: Welcome to Compass
welcome.body: Compass helps you see where your money goes. Let's start with the gentlest question: what are you saving for?
welcome.fieldHint: Anything works. You can change it later.

budgetStyle.title: Pick a budget style
budgetStyle.body: How you'd like to keep spending in check. Changeable later from Settings.
budgetStyle.monthlyLimitHint: Set an IDR cap per category. The simple, friendly default.
budgetStyle.envelopeHint: Pre-allocate cash per category at the start of the month.

account.title: Add your first account
account.body: Accounts are where your money lives — bank, e-wallet, credit card, cash. You can add more later.

firstBudget.title: Set this month's limits
firstBudget.body: Pick a few popular categories and set their limits. Leave whatever doesn't apply blank — you can come back any time.
firstBudget.skipHint: You can set these later from the Budgets tab.
